ABOUT

Bare Glow

Bare Glow started very simply — with a love for slow self-care, traditional ingredients, and the little rituals we grow up around without even realising how special they are. Growing up in an Indian household, skincare was never complicated.

It was homemade haldi masks before weddings, honey and lemon mixed in kitchen bowls, coconut oil rituals, and ingredients passed down through mums, aunties, and grandmothers long before “clean beauty” became a trend.

Bare Glow was inspired by those memories.

Every bar is handcrafted in small batches using ingredients chosen not just for how they look, but for how they make you feel — warm, comforted, fresh, glowy, and cared for.

We're not trying to promise perfection or miracle results. Our soaps are simply designed to turn everyday routines into little moments of calm and softness.

From creamy goat milk bases to citrus blends, turmeric, honey, oats, florals, and gentle exfoliants — each product is made with intention, inspired by traditional remedies and modern self-care rituals.

At Bare Glow, we believe skincare should feel personal, comforting, and beautiful — never overwhelming.

Thank you for supporting a small handmade business and being part of this journey 💚
